name: ОПОРА (Opora)
tagline: Ukrainian civic network for election monitoring, democratic integrity, and civic participation
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: High dependency on international donor funding; potential vulnerability to political pressure given Ukraine's geopolitical situation
news_articles: Guardian coverage of Ukrainian election monitoring
Reuters reporting on OPORA election observation missions
BBC News coverage of Ukrainian civic monitoring initiatives
academic_citations: Citations in academic literature on election monitoring and democratic governance in Eastern Europe
awards: Recognition as leading election monitoring organization in Ukraine

policy_outcomes.description: Presented research concept on Voter Register (Реєстр виборців) to Central Election Commission (ЦВК)
Launched Electoral Integrity Academy (Академія виборчої доброчесності) second wave

outcome_methodology: Observational studies and monitoring reports documenting election integrity issues and civic participation metrics
documented_limitations: Limited by access to certain election administration data; constrained by security concerns during conflict periods
failure_modes: Operational disruptions during military conflict; potential data collection challenges in occupied or contested territories
curation_criteria: Evidence-based election monitoring standards; adherence to international election observation guidelines
contributor_governance: Board-led governance with input from network of election observers and civil society partners
political_bias_allegations: OPORA maintains explicitly non-partisan stance; no credible bias allegations found
